title: The Honey Trap of the Three Kingdoms
synopsis: Getting rid of the Grand Master could be as easy as one beautiful woman…

fullText.simplified:
三国之美人计

    三国中有个著名的美人计的故事，它和中国古代四大美女之一的貂蝉有关。
    三国时期，董卓掌握了朝廷大权，变得十分骄横。他不仅强迫汉献帝迁都长安，而且根本不听汉献帝和大臣们的话，动不动就把反对自己的大臣给杀死了。朝廷中的大臣对他又恨又怕，都想除掉他，可又都想不出办法来。因为董卓的身边有一个武功高强的义子吕布在贴身保护他，其他人根本打不过吕布。
    大臣王允心里一直想着怎么才能除掉董卓。一天，他在后花园里散步，碰到了他家的歌女貂蝉。貂蝉美若天仙，而且能歌善舞，王允平时对她就像亲女儿一样。看着貂蝉，王允突然想到了一个能除掉董卓的好办法。他把自己的想法告诉了貂蝉，貂蝉为了感谢王允的养育之恩，答应帮助王允除掉董卓。
    首先，王允邀请吕布来家里喝酒。两人喝得高兴的时候，貂蝉过来陪酒。吕布看到貂蝉那么漂亮，就爱上了她。王允趁机说：“我想把干女儿貂蝉送给将军您做小妾，过两天就送到您家里，将军您愿意吗？”吕布当然求之不得，说了很多谢谢王允的话，高高兴兴地回家了。
    不久，王允又邀请董卓来家里喝酒。酒喝到一半时，王允让貂蝉前来跳舞。董卓和吕布一样，一见到貂蝉就两眼发直。王允在一旁看在眼里，酒宴结束后立即派人把貂蝉送进了董卓的家中。
    董卓娶了貂蝉后，非常疼爱她。吕布得知后，气得大发雷霆。貂蝉知道自己已经成功地走出了第一步。接下来，貂蝉故意向吕布暗送秋波，引起吕布的注意。几天后，貂蝉偷偷约吕布在后花园的湖边见面。貂蝉一见吕布就哭着说：“我对将军您一见钟情，原本还以为可以嫁给将军。没想到董太师竟然强娶了我，我当时真想一死了之。可为了能见将军一面，才忍辱活到今天。现在见到将军了，我的心愿已了，没什么可挂念的了。”说完，就要跳入湖中自杀，吕布连忙抱住貂蝉。这一幕正好被回到家的董卓看到了。他当即火冒三丈，冲上前要杀了吕布，吕布仓皇而逃。
    王允见时机成熟，便故意进一步激怒吕布，鼓励他杀了董卓，吕布同意了。于是，王允用计把董卓骗出来，半路派兵埋伏着。士兵一见到董卓就冲上去，拿起刀向董卓猛刺。董卓大叫：“吕布快来救我。”吕布从草丛中跳出来，却一刀刺死了董卓。
    这就是美人计。王允利用美人貂蝉离间了董卓和吕布，让他们因貂蝉而反目成仇。董卓和吕布联合在一起很强，谁也除不掉他们。但只要他们之间产生了间隙，除掉董卓就简单多了。
fullText.traditional:
三國之美人計

    三國中有個著名的美人計的故事，它和中國古代四大美女之一的貂蟬有關。
    三國時期，董卓掌握了朝廷大權，變得十分驕橫。他不僅強迫漢獻帝遷都長安，而且根本不聽漢獻帝和大臣們的話，動不動就把反對自己的大臣給殺死了。朝廷中的大臣對他又恨又怕，都想除掉他，可又都想不出辦法來。因為董卓的身邊有一個武功高強的義子呂布在貼身保護他，其他人根本打不過呂布。
    大臣王允心裡一直想著怎麼才能除掉董卓。一天，他在後花園裡散步，碰到了他家的歌女貂蟬。貂蟬美若天仙，而且能歌善舞，王允平時對她就像親女兒一樣。看著貂蟬，王允突然想到了一個能除掉董卓的好辦法。他把自己的想法告訴了貂蟬，貂蟬為了感謝王允的養育之恩，答應幫助王允除掉董卓。
    首先，王允邀請呂布來家裡喝酒。兩人喝得高興的時候，貂蟬過來陪酒。呂布看到貂蟬那麼漂亮，就愛上了她。王允趁機說：“我想把乾女兒貂蟬送給將軍您做小妾，過兩天就送到您家裡，將軍您願意嗎？”呂布當然求之不得，說了很多謝謝王允的話，高高興興地回家了。
    不久，王允又邀請董卓來家裡喝酒。酒喝到一半時，王允讓貂蟬前來跳舞。董卓和呂布一樣，一見到貂蟬就兩眼發直。王允在一旁看在眼裡，酒宴結束後立即派人把貂蟬送進了董卓的家中。
    董卓娶了貂蟬後，非常疼愛她。呂布得知後，氣得大發雷霆。貂蟬知道自己已經成功地走出了第一步。接下來，貂蟬故意向呂布暗送秋波，引起呂布的注意。幾天後，貂蟬偷偷約呂布在後花園的湖邊見面。貂蟬一見呂布就哭著說：“我對將軍您一見鐘情，原本還以為可以嫁給將軍。沒想到董太師竟然強娶了我，我當時真想一死了之。可為了能見將軍一面，才忍辱活到今天。現在見到將軍了，我的心願已了，沒什麼可掛念的了。”說完，就要跳入湖中自殺，呂布連忙抱住貂蟬。這一幕正好被回到家的董卓看到了。他當即火冒三丈，衝上前要殺了呂布，呂布倉皇而逃。
    王允見時機成熟，便故意進一步激怒呂布，鼓勵他殺了董卓，呂布同意了。於是，王允用計把董卓騙出來，半路派兵埋伏著。士兵一見到董卓就衝上去，拿起刀向董卓猛刺。董卓大叫：“呂布快來救我。”呂布從草叢中跳出來，卻一刀刺死了董卓。
    這就是美人計。王允利用美人貂蟬離間了董卓和呂布，讓他們因貂蟬而反目成仇。董卓和呂布聯合在一起很強，誰也除不掉他們。但只要他們之間產生了間隙，除掉董卓就簡單多了。

sentences.simplified: 没想到董太师竟然强娶了我，我当时真想一死了之。
sentences.traditional: 沒想到董太師竟然強娶了我，我當時真想一死了之。
sentences.pinyin: méi xiǎng dào dǒng tài shī jìng rán qiǎng qǔ le wǒ wǒ dāng shí zhēn xiǎng yì sǐ liǎo zhī
sentences.english: ″I fell in love at first sight of you, General, and originally believed I would even be able to marry you.

sentences.simplified: 可为了能见将军一面，才忍辱活到今天。
sentences.traditional: 可為了能見將軍一面，才忍辱活到今天。
sentences.pinyin: kě wèi le néng jiàn jiāng jūn yí miàn cái rěn rǔ huó dào jīn tiān
sentences.english: I never would’ve thought that Grand Master Dong would unexpectedly forcefully marry me. At that time, I really wanted to commit suicide.

sentences.simplified: 现在见到将军了，我的心愿已了，没什么可挂念的了。”
sentences.traditional: 現在見到將軍了，我的心願已了，沒什麼可掛念的了。”
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài jiàn dào jiāng jūn le wǒ de xīn yuàn yǐ liǎo méi shén me kě guà niàn de le
sentences.english: But for the sake of being able to see General again once more, I endured it to live until today.

sentences.simplified: 说完，就要跳入湖中自杀，吕布连忙抱住貂蝉。
sentences.traditional: 說完，就要跳入湖中自殺，呂布連忙抱住貂蟬。
sentences.pinyin: shuō wán jiù yào tiào rù hú zhōng zì shā lǚ bù lián máng bào zhù diāo chán
sentences.english: Now that I’ve been able to see General, my wish has already been granted, and there is nothing more to hold onto.”

sentences.simplified: 这一幕正好被回到家的董卓看到了。
sentences.traditional: 這一幕正好被回到家的董卓看到了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yí mù zhèng hǎo bèi huí dào jiā de dǒng zhuó kàn dào le
sentences.english: After she said this, she attempted to jump into the lake to commit suicide. Lü Bu at once held onto Diaochan.

sentences.simplified: 他当即火冒三丈，冲上前要杀了吕布，吕布仓皇而逃。
sentences.traditional: 他當即火冒三丈，衝上前要殺了呂布，呂布倉皇而逃。
sentences.pinyin: tā dāng jí huǒ mào sān zhàng chōng shàng qián yào shā le lǚ bù lǚ bù cāng huáng ér táo
sentences.english: This act just so happened to be seen by Dong Zhuo who had just returned home.
He immediately went into a rage and rushed forward to kill Lü Bu. Lü Bu escaped in a flurry.

sentences.simplified: 王允见时机成熟，便故意进一步激怒吕布，鼓励他杀了董卓，
sentences.traditional: 王允見時機成熟，便故意進一步激怒呂布，鼓勵他殺了董卓，
sentences.pinyin: wáng yǔn jiàn shí jī chéng shú biàn gù yì jìn yí bù jī nù lǚ bù gǔ lì tā shā le dǒng zhuó

sentences.simplified: 吕布同意了。
sentences.traditional: 呂布同意了。
sentences.pinyin: lǚ bù tóng yì le
sentences.english: Seeing the opportunity ripening, Wang Yun proceeded to deliberately enrage Lü Bu further, encouraging him to kill Dong Zhuo.

sentences.simplified: 于是，王允用计把董卓骗出来，半路派兵埋伏着。
sentences.traditional: 於是，王允用計把董卓騙出來，半路派兵埋伏著。
sentences.pinyin: yú shì wáng yǔn yòng jì bǎ dǒng zhuó piàn chū lái bàn lù pài bīng mái fú zhe
sentences.english: Lü Bu agreed.

sentences.simplified: 士兵一见到董卓就冲上去，拿起刀向董卓猛刺。
sentences.traditional: 士兵一見到董卓就衝上去，拿起刀向董卓猛刺。
sentences.pinyin: shì bīng yí jiàn dào dǒng zhuó jiù chōng shàng qù ná qǐ dāo xiàng dǒng zhuó měng cì
sentences.english: Then, Wang Yun tricked Dong Zhuo into coming out, and dispatched troops to ambush him midway.

sentences.simplified: 董卓大叫：
sentences.traditional: 董卓大叫：
sentences.pinyin: dǒng zhuó dà jiào
sentences.english: As soon as the soldiers saw Dong Zhuo, they rushed forward, picking up a blade to ferociously stab Dong Zhuo.

sentences.simplified: “吕布快来救我。”吕布从草丛中跳出来，却一刀刺死了董卓。
sentences.traditional: “呂布快來救我。”呂布從草叢中跳出來，卻一刀刺死了董卓。
sentences.pinyin: lǚ bù kuài lái jiù wǒ lǚ bù cóng cǎo cóng zhōng tiào chū lái què yì dāo cì sǐ le dǒng zhuó
sentences.english: Dong Zhuo yelled:
“Lü Bu, quickly come and save me!” Lü Bu jumped out from the underbrush, but instead killed Dong Zhuo with one stab.

sentences.simplified: 这就是美人计。
sentences.traditional: 這就是美人計。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù shì měi rén jì

sentences.simplified: 王允利用美人貂蝉离间了董卓和吕布，让他们因貂蝉而反目成仇。
sentences.traditional: 王允利用美人貂蟬離間了董卓和呂布，讓他們因貂蟬而反目成仇。
sentences.pinyin: wáng yǔn lì yòng měi rén diāo chán lí jiàn le dǒng zhuó hé lǚ bù ràng tā men yīn diāo chán ér fǎn mù chéng chóu
sentences.english: This is the honey trap.

sentences.simplified: 董卓和吕布联合在一起很强，谁也除不掉他们。
sentences.traditional: 董卓和呂布聯合在一起很強，誰也除不掉他們。
sentences.pinyin: dǒng zhuó hé lǚ bù lián hé zài yì qǐ hěn qiáng shéi yě chú bú diào tā men
sentences.english: Wang Yun used the beauty Diaochan to separate Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu, and made them become enemies because of Diaochan.

sentences.simplified: 但只要他们之间产生了间隙，除掉董卓就简单多了。
sentences.traditional: 但只要他們之間產生了間隙，除掉董卓就簡單多了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn zhǐ yào tā men zhī jiān chǎn shēng le jiàn xì chú diào dǒng zhuó jiù jiǎn dān duō le
sentences.english: Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu were very strong when combined together. Nobody could get rid of them.
But if they could be separated, getting rid of Dong Zhuo became much easier.

raw.synopsis: Getting rid of the Grand Master could be as easy as one beautiful woman…
sentence_translations: The honey trap of the Three Kingdoms
There is a famous story about a honey trap during the Three Kingdoms involving one of the Four Great Beauties of Ancient China.
In the Three Kingdoms period, Dong Zhuo seized control of the imperial court, and became very arrogant.
He not only forced the Emperor Xian of Han to move the capital Chang’an, but also didn’t listen to the Emperor or the ministers, ..
.. and was apt to kill any cabinet minister who opposed him.
The cabinet ministers of the imperial court hated and feared him, all wanting to get rid of him, yet none could think a way.
Because Dong Zhuo had his highly-skilled martial artist adopted son Lü Bu close by to protect him and no one could not defeat Lü Bu.
Deep down, the cabinet minister Wang Yun continuously tried to figure out how to get rid of Dong Zhuo.
One day, as he was walking around the back garden, he ran into his household’s female singer, Diaochan.
Diaochan was as beautiful as a deity, and could also sing and dance. Wang Yun normally treated her as though she was his own daughter.
Seeing Diaochan, Wang Yun suddenly thought of a good way to get rid of Dong Zhuo.
He told Diaochan his idea. Diaochan, in order to show gratitude to Wang Yun for raising her, agreed to help Wang Yun get rid of Dong Zhuo.
First, Wang Yun invited Lü Bu to his home for drinks.
When the two of them became merry from the alcohol, Diaochan came over to accompany them in drinking.
As soon as Lü Bu saw how beautiful Diaochan was, he fell in love with her.
Wang Yun took advantage of the situation and said:
“I want to give my adopted daughter Diaochan to you, General, to be your concubine.
I will send her to your home in a few days. General, would you be willing?
Lü Bu of course was most exceedingly willing, saying many words of thanks to Wang Yun, and cheerfully returned home.
Not long after, Wang Yun also invited Dong Zhuo to his home for drinks.
Halfway through the drinks, Wang Yun got Diaochan to come and dance.
Dong Zhuo was the same as Lü Bu. As soon as he saw Diaochan, his eyes fixated on her.
Wang Yun observed this, ..
.. and after the feast ended, he immediately sent servants to deliver Diaochan to Dong Zhuo’s home.
After Dong Zhuo married Diaochan, he loved her very dearly.
After Lü Bu found out, he went into a terrible rage.
Diaochan knew that she had already successfully completed the first step.
Next, Diaochan deliberately cast flirtatious glances at Lü Bu, gaining his attention.
A few days later, Diaochan secretly asked Lü Bu to come to the lake in the back garden so they could see each other.
As soon as Diaochan saw Lü Bu, she burst into tears, saying:
″I fell in love at first sight of you, General, and originally believed I would even be able to marry you.
I never would’ve thought that Grand Master Dong would unexpectedly forcefully marry me. At that time, I really wanted to commit suicide.
But for the sake of being able to see General again once more, I endured it to live until today.
Now that I’ve been able to see General, my wish has already been granted, and there is nothing more to hold onto.”
After she said this, she attempted to jump into the lake to commit suicide. Lü Bu at once held onto Diaochan.
This act just so happened to be seen by Dong Zhuo who had just returned home.
He immediately went into a rage and rushed forward to kill Lü Bu. Lü Bu escaped in a flurry.
Seeing the opportunity ripening, Wang Yun proceeded to deliberately enrage Lü Bu further, encouraging him to kill Dong Zhuo.
Lü Bu agreed.
Then, Wang Yun tricked Dong Zhuo into coming out, and dispatched troops to ambush him midway.
As soon as the soldiers saw Dong Zhuo, they rushed forward, picking up a blade to ferociously stab Dong Zhuo.
Dong Zhuo yelled:
“Lü Bu, quickly come and save me!” Lü Bu jumped out from the underbrush, but instead killed Dong Zhuo with one stab.
This is the honey trap.
Wang Yun used the beauty Diaochan to separate Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu, and made them become enemies because of Diaochan.
Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu were very strong when combined together. Nobody could get rid of them.
But if they could be separated, getting rid of Dong Zhuo became much easier.
